_note: The home's featured works, as a mosaic of justified rows (2026-10-21, after omegarender.com): every row fills the width and its tiles share one height, so each tile's width follows its ratio. A tile is a project's image (slug/n from data/projects.json) shown at ratio r, cropped with object-fit around the focus point fx, fy (0 to 1). Below 768 px each tile takes a row of its own.
